Each sermon offers a different message using biblical prophecy, Christian doctrine, the present truth, practical Christian living, and biblical teachings through the lens of history. Tune in to find encouragement for strengthening your faith, renewing your spirit and living in harmony with God's will.

The End of Religion is a cinematic documentary series that uncovers the hidden truths behind organized religion.
In the series, Vincent embarks on a global journey to uncover why religion has caused so much evil in the world—only to stumble upon a shocking discovery that changes everything.

Featuring updates from our pastoral department, testimonies from the field, new media projects, and upcoming initiatives — all designed to inform, inspire, and invite you to become part of the mission.

title: Mind Wars - Eric Walsh
description: In this three-part series, Eric Walsh exposes Satan’s attempts to distract us from the soon return of Jesus Christ through his subtle threats upon our generation. Though especially aimed at young people, this series offers a warning relevant to all ages.

description:
Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them.
Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

Whether tackling menstrual irregularities, fertility concerns, hormone imbalance, or just wanting to understand the female anatomy, this series gives viewers a deeper understanding of the body, mind and spirit connection. We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.
